name: ranch-savanna
description: Ranch, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10e): the shipped Ranch drawn again as a herder's stable: a red granite stable range under a skirt of golden thatch hipped on all four sides, the hay loft rising out of it as a mud clerestory under a second, higher thatch hip with a clay pot on its ridge, a thatched kraal gate before an acacia-railed yard, and (II) a mud bunk house under a thatch pyramid and a kraal behind with an acacia shade tree and a thatched shelter. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.
